Usage: bb [options] [command]

BB CLI - manage your AI coding agents

Options:
  -V, --version                      output the version number
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  device                             Hand off text and URLs to a device viewing
                                     the origin
  browser                            Experimental built-in desktop browser
                                     control
  status [options]                   Show current context
  settings                           Inspect and update BB settings
  project                            Inspect and manage projects
  prompt-history                     List prompt history across threads and
                                     projects
  provider                           Manage providers and inspect their models
  spend                              Token and usage totals recorded by the
                                     server
  manager                            Compatibility notice for removed manager
                                     commands
  machine                            Inspect execution machines
  server                             Move, export, and import the bb server
  updates                            Inspect and apply bb and provider CLI
                                     updates
  terminal                           Manage terminal sessions across threads,
                                     environments, and machines
  thread                             Manage threads
  environment                        Inspect and operate on first-class
                                     environments
  file                               Read and manage files on BB machines
  theme                              Manage the app theme and favicon color
  plugin                             Manage BB plugins
  marketplace                        Manage the plugin marketplaces bb reads
                                     catalogs from
  skill                              List, inspect, edit, install, and remove
                                     skills
  guide [options] [chapter] [group]  Show the BB system overview and CLI guide;
                                     `bb guide commands [group]` lists every
                                     core command on one page
  diagnostics                        Inspect local bb CLI diagnostics
  voice                              Voice input utilities
  help [command]                     display help for command


Current context:
  BB_PROJECT_ID: <unset>
  BB_THREAD_ID: <unset>
  BB_SERVER_URL: https://claramente.getbb.app

Quick start:
  bb status
  bb project list
  bb thread show <id>
  bb thread spawn --project <id> --provider codex --prompt "..."
